description: Les choix de production électrique : anticiper et maîtriser les risques technologiques, techniques et financiers is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Cour des comptes. The Court publishes notes forming part of a series of work on several major public policies, which identify both the main challenges and levers that will be faced by public decision-makers in the coming years. Coverage: Cour des comptes. The portal shows the English title as "Electrical production choices: anticipating and controlling technological, technical and financial risks" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Cour des comptes. Its keywords include production-electrique, electricite. The listing shows 1 download or service links in UTF8. The listing shows 2022-03-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
